<documents>
<document id="products-under-18">
Accountsˆforˆunder-18sˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpeopleˆagedˆ18ˆandˆover.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆteenˆaccounts,ˆcustodialˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆchildren.ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆyoungˆpersonˆIfˆyourˆchildˆhasˆanˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆyouˆcanˆsendˆmoneyˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ##ˆAddingˆaˆchildˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcan'tˆaddˆaˆchildˆasˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆgiveˆthemˆaˆcardˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheyˆturnˆ18ˆTheyˆcanˆapplyˆforˆtheirˆownˆaccountˆinˆtheˆappˆwithˆtheirˆownˆIDˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆparent'sˆaccountˆPleaseˆdon'tˆletˆsomeoneˆelseˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆapp.ˆTransactionsˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆtoˆaren'tˆcoveredˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆStudentsˆStudentsˆagedˆ18ˆandˆoverˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆlikeˆanyoneˆelse.ˆ##ˆGiftsˆforˆaˆchildˆWeˆcan'tˆholdˆmoneyˆonˆaˆchild'sˆbehalf.ˆIfˆyouˆwantˆtoˆsaveˆforˆaˆchild,ˆyouˆcanˆcreateˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆinˆyourˆownˆaccountˆandˆnameˆitˆafterˆthem.ˆTheˆmoneyˆstaysˆyours.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-ach">
DisputingˆanˆACHˆdebitˆAnˆACHˆdebitˆisˆwhenˆaˆcompanyˆpullsˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumber,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆutilityˆbillˆorˆaˆloanˆpayment.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆACHˆdebitsˆIfˆaˆcompanyˆtookˆmoneyˆyouˆdidn'tˆauthorize,ˆreportˆitˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆIˆdidn'tˆauthorizeˆthis.ˆ##ˆAuthorized,ˆbutˆwrongˆIfˆyouˆdidˆauthorizeˆtheˆcompanyˆbutˆtheˆamountˆorˆdateˆisˆwrong,ˆcontactˆtheˆcompanyˆfirst.ˆIfˆthatˆdoesn'tˆwork,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆitˆwithˆyou.ˆ##ˆStoppingˆfutureˆdebitsˆYouˆcanˆblockˆaˆcompanyˆfromˆpullingˆmoneyˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆBlockˆfutureˆdebits.ˆTellˆtheˆcompanyˆtoo,ˆsoˆtheyˆknowˆtoˆbillˆyouˆanotherˆway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWe'llˆaskˆtheˆcompany'sˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney.ˆIfˆyourˆclaimˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆACHˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆandˆBrookPayˆpayments,ˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputedˆthisˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-basic">
CushionˆonˆBasicˆCushionˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆdebitˆcardˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆCushionˆisˆpartˆofˆtheˆpaidˆplans.ˆIt'sˆhowˆweˆgiveˆmembersˆaˆlittleˆroomˆwithoutˆchargingˆoverdraftˆfees.ˆ##ˆGettingˆCushionˆMoveˆtoˆPlusˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00,ˆorˆtoˆPremiumˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆOverdraftˆfeesˆBasicˆhasˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00).ˆTransactionsˆthatˆwouldˆoverdrawˆyourˆaccountˆareˆdeclinedˆinstead.ˆ##ˆCanˆaˆBasicˆbalanceˆgoˆnegative?ˆOccasionally,ˆforˆexampleˆifˆaˆmerchantˆpostsˆmoreˆthanˆitˆauthorizedˆorˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆdepositˆrepaysˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆautomatically.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆdeclinedˆtransaction.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
